description: Main FirmDesk window: the staff web UI plus OS integrations. The webview talks to the API origin via the normal credentialed fetch wrapper (no extra HTTP plugin needed); Tally's localhost:9000 is reached only by the Rust relay command, so no wildcard URL scope exists at the webview layer. External browser use is limited to the Google sign-in consent pages (opener plugin, scoped), and inbound firmdesk:// deep links carry only the OAuth handoff key.
